title: Southern Amami Ōshima language
displaytitle: Southern Amami Ōshima language

titles.display: Southern Amami Ōshima language

extract: The Southern Amami Ōshima language is a Ryukyuan language spoken in Setouchi, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. It is generally considered to be the southern variety of the Amami Ōshima language, whereas a separate northern variety exists.
